title: 第五章 魔氛蔽山野 三神战群邪第六章 幽谷逢仙姝 花影蕴玄机

玉帝仙驭归天，金辉散尽，山岚复清，暖阳遍洒林峦，枯木抽芽，幽草复生，周遭戾气荡涤殆尽。何年、何月、何日三子执玉简而立，神思澄澈，宿命明了，周身神蕴虽未全解，却已得天篆大道根基，心性已然迥异凡童。
何年轻抚怀中玉简，玉质温凉，天篆道韵隐隐流转，与自身年神本源息息相通。抬眼望弟妹，何月眉目温婉，月华内敛，周身透着清和之气；何日身形挺拔，日光潜运，眉宇间刚正之气愈盛。遂整束衣衫，沉声道：“师父已授《六千字文》大道真经，嘱我等守心、向善、循道、同心，以补时序玉璧，救三界苍生。此地戾气虽清，然天地时序崩坏之祸未止，魔界邪祟必闻风而动，前路必多凶险，我等需步步谨慎，同心共济，切勿有负师命。”
何月敛衽颔首，柔声道：“兄长所言极是。我虽法力微薄，亦当以月华之力调和阴阳，安抚戾气，护持弟妹，共赴劫途。”
何日握拳，周身金光微漾，意气铿锵：“有《六千字文》在身，有神道本源在体，纵有千妖万魔，我亦敢以骄阳之力，荡平邪祟！必护兄长阿姐，斩邪救世，绝不退缩！”
三人心意既定，不复多言，循着山间小径，稳步前行。虽辞故土，却不离此方天地，盖因时序之乱，遍于寰宇，就地历劫，荡除周遭魔邪，梳理一方气机，亦是修行正道，无需远游西行。
行不过数里，方才澄澈之天色，骤然暗沉。方才和畅之山风，陡然变厉，呼啸作响，卷得落叶漫天飞舞。一股浓郁至极、凶戾无比的黑浊之气，自前方山谷汹涌而出，遮天蔽日，顷刻间便将朗朗乾坤，化作昏冥之境。
此气绝非山间戾气可比，阴寒、霸道、凶煞、贪婪，裹挟着毁天灭地之邪威，透着吞噬万物之戾气，所过之处，草木瞬间枯萎，山石隐隐开裂，天地间阴阳气机，被搅得大乱，时序紊乱之象，愈发剧烈。
何年面色骤变，当即止步，抬手拦住弟妹，凝神运转《六千字文》中年岁时序之法，感知周遭气机，沉声道：“此乃魔界浊气，凶煞异常，远超此前墨雾戾气，定是魔界邪魔，感知我等神道气息，前来阻拦！”
何月娇躯微凛，月华之气自发弥漫，护住周身，蹙眉道：“魔界之众，素来觊觎时序玉璧，欲借天地大乱，倾覆三界，独霸乾坤。我等刚得天篆大道，神力初醒，便引魔众前来，此番劫数，甚是凶险。”
何日双目圆睁，周身金光迸发，怒视前方魔云，朗声道：“来得正好！我正欲一试《六千字文》所载骄阳神通，今日便斩尽这些邪魔，以正天地大道！”
话音未落，前方魔云翻滚，轰然炸开，无数魔兵魔将，自云间踏出，密密麻麻，遍布山野，一眼望不到尽头。
为首者，乃是一尊魔帅，身形丈余，身披玄铁甲胄，周身黑焰腾腾，头生三角，面如蓝靛，目绽猩红凶光，手持一柄九环魔刀，刀身萦绕漆黑魔雾，透着蚀魂夺魄之威。其周身魔气浩瀚，远超寻常魔将，乃是魔界镇守一方的玄煞魔帅，专司破坏天地时序，吸纳乱序之气，修炼魔功。
玄煞魔帅身后，分列四尊魔将，各持兵刃，气息凶戾，或持魔矛，或握魔斧，周身魔气翻滚，凶神恶煞。再往后，便是无数魔兵，青面獠牙，身形狰狞，手持刀枪剑戟，嘶吼不断，魔啸之声，震彻山林，令天地为之震颤。
玄煞魔帅抬眼，猩红目光死死锁定何年三人，桀桀怪笑，声如破锣，震得人耳膜生疼：“吾当是何方神圣，引得天地气机异动，原来是天界贬下凡间的年月日三小神！尔等褪了神位，封了神力，不过凡胎稚童，竟还敢怀揣天篆真经，妄图修补时序玉璧，简直痴心妄想！”
何日上前一步，横身护在兄长阿姐身前，厉声呵斥：“邪魔休得狂言！天地大道有序，三界生灵安宁，岂容尔等魔界邪祟肆意破坏！我等奉天命历劫，得玉帝亲传《六千字文》，今日便要替天行道，荡除尔等魔众！”
“玉帝？”玄煞魔帅闻言，仰天大笑，笑声中满是不屑与狂傲，“如今时序崩坏，玉璧碎裂，天道衰微，玉帝自身难保，安能护得尔等？这三界，终将是我魔界天下！今日，吾便擒下尔等三人，抽其神道本源，夺其天篆真经，炼化之后，吾便可突破魔功，成为魔界至尊，亲手覆灭三界秩序！”
说罢，玄煞魔帅挥手，厉声下令：“众魔兵听令，将这三个稚童拿下，死活不论，务必夺取天篆玉简！”
“遵令！”
万千魔兵齐声嘶吼，声震云霄，手持兵刃，如潮水般朝着何年三人冲杀而来。魔兵所过之处，魔气肆虐，草木成灰，大地开裂，凶威滔天。

“弟妹，莫慌！依《六千字文》三才之理，列阵迎敌！”何年厉声喝道，身形陡然一纵，立于正中方位，双手掐动天篆道诀，周身莹白时序之气，轰然爆发。
何月身形一晃，立于左侧，双手结印，月华之力尽数施展，漫天银辉自体内涌出，如流水般环绕周身，阴阳调和之气，缓缓铺开。
何日踏立右侧，周身金光璀璨，如一轮小太阳升腾，骄阳正气直冲云霄，至阳至刚之力，震慑群魔，正是《六千字文》所载日神破邪之法。
三才方位既定，三神同时默念《六千字文》经文，年神时序、月神阴阳、日神骄阳，三道神力，以天篆经文为引，瞬间交融一体，形成一道三色光罩，将三人护在中央。
“轰！”
最先冲至的数名魔兵，挥刀砍在光罩之上，瞬间被光罩上的大道之力震得身躯崩裂，魔气消散，魂飞魄散。
然魔兵数量众多，悍不畏死，前赴后继，源源不断地冲杀而来，魔刃、魔矛不断轰击在光罩之上，发出震天巨响。光罩之上，光芒闪烁，隐隐有晃动之态，三人只觉周身神力飞速消耗，气血翻涌。
玄煞魔帅见状，冷哼一声：“区区三才小阵，也敢在本座面前卖弄！”
言罢，他纵身跃起，手中九环魔刀高举，漆黑魔力疯狂汇聚，刀身之上，魔纹闪烁，凝聚起一股足以撕裂天地的凶戾之力，朝着光罩狠狠劈下。
“魔啸裂天斩！”
一刀落下，魔啸震天，漆黑刀芒裹挟着无尽魔气，轰然砸在三才光罩之上。
“咔嚓！”
光罩瞬间出现一道裂痕，三人齐声闷哼，嘴角溢出丝丝血迹，神力耗损剧增。
“兄长，这魔帅功力深厚，刀势凶戾，光罩快守不住了！”何月脸色苍白，月华之力飞速输出，拼命稳固光罩，柔声急呼。
何日双目赤红，催动全部日神之力，金光暴涨，厉声喝道：“兄长，我来破他！”
说罢，何日不顾自身消耗，纵身跃出光罩，双手凝聚骄阳神力，按照《六千字文》所载“阳炎破邪诀”，朝着玄煞魔帅轰然打出。
“骄阳贯日！”
一道璀璨金芒，如烈日坠落，带着至阳至刚之威，直扑玄煞魔帅。
玄煞魔帅见状，嘴角勾起一抹讥讽，魔刀横挥，轻易便挡下何日一击，反手一刀，朝着何日劈去。魔刀之上，魔气肆虐，阴寒之力，直逼何日神魂。
“三弟小心！”何年见状，大惊失色，当即催动时序之力，口中念动天篆经文：“时序流转，乾坤定止！”

无形的时序之力，瞬间笼罩玄煞魔帅，令其刀势陡然一滞，动作慢了数分。
何日趁机抽身后退，躲过致命一击，心中惊悸不已，方才若非兄长以时序之力牵制，自己必遭魔刀所伤。
“小小稚童，竟能以时序之力阻我，倒是有些门道！”玄煞魔帅眼中凶光更盛，不再留手，周身魔气暴涨，身后浮现出一头巨大的魔影，张牙舞爪，凶威滔天，“既然如此，本座便先灭了你！”
他舍弃何日，魔刀一转，朝着阵中的何年劈去，欲先破阵眼，覆灭三人阵法。
“阿兄！”何月、何日齐声惊呼，双双出手。

When the Jade Emperor passed away, the golden light dissipated, the mountains were clear again, the warm sun spread over the forest, the dead trees sprouted, the grass regenerated, and the vicious atmosphere around him was wiped away. In what year, what month, and what day, the three sons stood holding the jade slips. Their thoughts were clear and their destiny was clear. Although the spiritual accumulation around them was not fully understood, they had already gained the foundation of the Tianzhuan Dao, and their minds were already very different from those of ordinary children.
He Nianqing caresses the jade slip in his arms. The jade is warm and cool, and the rhyme of the Chinese seal script is faintly flowing, which is closely connected with the origin of his own Nian Shen. Looking up at his younger siblings, He Yue's eyebrows are gentle, the moonlight is restrained, and his whole body exudes a peaceful aura; He Yue's body is tall and straight, and the sunlight is flowing, and the righteousness between his brows becomes stronger. Then he straightened his clothes and said in a deep voice: "Master has taught the Great Dao Sutra "The Six Thousand Characters Essay" and told us to keep our hearts, be kind, follow the Tao, and be united in order to replenish the time sequence jade and save the people of the three realms. Although the evil spirit here is clear, the disaster of the collapse of the time sequence of heaven and earth is not over. The evil spirits in the devil world will surely move at the wind, and the road ahead will be dangerous. We need to be careful every step, work together, and never betray the master's orders."
He Yue folded his hands and nodded, and said softly: "What my brother said is absolutely true. Even though my magic power is meager, I should use the power of the moonlight to reconcile yin and yang, appease the anger, and protect my brothers and sisters on the road to disaster."
Heri clenched his fist, the golden light around his body shimmered slightly, and he said with a sonorous voice: "With the "Six Thousand Character Essay" in my body, and the source of Shinto in my body, even if there are thousands of demons, I dare to use the power of the scorching sun to wipe out evil spirits! I will protect my brother and sister, kill evil and save the world, and never back down!"
The three of them had their minds set, and without further words, they followed the mountain path and moved forward steadily. Although you leave your homeland, you never leave this place. Due to the chaos of time, it spreads all over the world. Going through tribulations on the spot, eradicating the evil spirits around you, and sorting out the energy of a place is also a way of cultivating the right path. There is no need to travel far to the west.
After walking only a few miles, the sky, which had just become clear, suddenly turned dark. The gentle mountain wind that had just been gentle suddenly became fierce, whistling, and causing fallen leaves to fly all over the sky. An extremely rich and ferocious black air surged out from the valley in front, covering the sky and the sun, and instantly turned the bright world into a state of darkness.
This aura is by no means comparable to the violent aura in the mountains. It is cold, domineering, ferocious, and greedy. It carries the evil power of destroying the heaven and the earth, and reveals the ruthless aura that devours all things. Wherever it passes, the grass and trees instantly wither, and the rocks crack faintly. The yin and yang qi between the heaven and the earth are thrown into chaos, and the phenomenon of time sequence disorder becomes more and more intense.
He Nian's complexion suddenly changed, he immediately stopped, raised his hand to stop his younger siblings, and concentrated on running the method of the order of years in the "Six Thousand Character Essay", sensing the energy around him, and said in a deep voice: "This is the turbid energy of the demon world, extremely ferocious, far beyond the previous violent aura of the ink mist, it must be the evil spirit of the demon world, sense the aura of our Shinto, come and stop it!"
He Yue's delicate body trembled slightly, and the energy of the moonlight spontaneously filled the air, protecting her whole body. She frowned and said, "The demon world has always coveted the Jade of Time. They want to take advantage of the chaos in the world to overturn the three realms and dominate the world. As soon as we obtained the Tianzhuan Avenue and awakened our divine power, we attracted the demons to come. This disaster is very dangerous."
Heri's eyes widened, golden light burst out from his body, he glared at the demonic clouds in front of him, and said loudly: "You've come just in time! I'm just about to try the magical power of the blazing sun contained in the "Six Thousand Character Essay". Today I will kill all these evil spirits to rectify the way of heaven and earth!"
Before he finished speaking, the demonic clouds in front rolled and exploded. Countless demonic soldiers and generals stepped out from the clouds, densely packed all over the mountains and fields, with no end as far as the eye could see.
The leader is a demon commander, more than ten feet tall, wearing black iron armor, with black flames rising all over his body. His head is triangular, his face is like indigo, and his eyes are scarlet and fierce. He is holding a nine-ring demon sword, and the blade is surrounded by dark magic mist, exuding the soul-eating power. The demonic energy around him is vast, far beyond that of ordinary demon generals. He is the Xuansha Demon Commander who guards one side of the demon world. He specializes in destroying the time order of heaven and earth, absorbing the energy of disorder, and practicing demonic skills.
Behind Demon Commander Xuansha, there are four demon generals, each holding a weapon, with a ferocious aura, some holding a demon spear, some holding a demon axe, the demonic aura rolling around his body, and a fierce look. Further behind, there are countless demonic soldiers, with green faces and fangs, ferocious figures, holding swords, spears, swords and halberds, and they are roaring continuously., the sound of the demonic roar shook through the mountains and forests, making the heaven and earth tremble.
Demon Commander Xuansha raised his eyes, his scarlet gaze fixed on He Nian and the three of them. Jiejie laughed strangely, the sound was like a broken gong, which made people's eardrums hurt: "Who am I to be the god who caused the heaven and earth to move? It turns out that it is The three little gods of the year, month, and day who were demoted from heaven to the mortal world! You have lost your divine status and gained your divine power, but you are still a mortal child, and you still dare to carry the Heavenly Seal Scripture and try to repair the Jade Bid of Time. What a wishful thinking!"
He Ri took a step forward, stood in front of his brother and sister, and yelled sternly: "Evil demons must not speak arrogantly! The world is in order, and the living beings in the three realms are peaceful. How can we allow you and other evil spirits from the demon world to destroy it wantonly! We have endured calamities under the destiny of God, and have received the "Six Thousand Characters Essay" personally passed down by the Jade Emperor. Today, we will do justice for heaven and eliminate you and other demons!"
"Jade Emperor?" Hearing this, Demon Commander Xuansha looked up to the sky and laughed, his laughter full of disdain and arrogance, "Now that time has collapsed, the jade is broken, and the way of heaven is declining, the Jade Emperor himself cannot be protected, how can he protect you? In these three realms, It will eventually be my demon world! Today, I will capture you and the other three, extract the source of their divine ways, and seize their Heavenly Seal Manual. After refining it, I can break through the demon power, become the supreme master of the demon world, and destroy the order of the three realms with my own hands!"
After that, Demon Commander Xuan Sha waved his hand and gave a stern order: "All the demon soldiers obey the order and capture these three children. No matter life or death, they must seize the Tianzhuan Jade Slips!"
"Follow the order!"
Thousands of demon soldiers roared in unison, the sound shook the sky, holding weapons in hand, and rushed towards He Nian and the three of them like a tide. Wherever the demonic soldiers passed, the demonic energy raged, the vegetation turned to ashes, the earth cracked, and the fierce power was overwhelming.
"Brothers and sisters, don't panic! According to the principles of the Three Talents in "The Six Thousand Character Essay", form an array to meet the enemy!" He Nian shouted sternly, his body suddenly straightened up, he stood in the middle, pinched the Tianzhu Dao Jue with both hands, and the white time sequence energy all over his body suddenly exploded.
He Yue's figure swayed, standing on the left side, forming seals with both hands, exerting all the power of the moonlight, and the silver light from the sky gushes out from the body, surrounding the body like flowing water, and the harmonious energy of yin and yang slowly spreads out.
When he stands on the right side, the golden light around his body is bright, like a small sun rising, and the scorching sun's righteousness shoots straight into the sky. The power of the sun is so strong that it can frighten all the demons. This is exactly the method of the sun god to destroy evil as recorded in the "Six Thousand Characters Essay".
The positions of the three talents were determined, and the three gods silently recited the "Six Thousand Character Classic" scripture at the same time. The three divine powers of the year god, the moon god yin and yang, and the sun god blazing sun, guided by the Tianzhuan scriptures, instantly merged into one, forming a three-color light shield to protect the three people in the center.
"Boom!"
The first few demon soldiers who rushed to slashed at the light shield with their swords. Their bodies were instantly shattered by the power of the avenue on the light shield, their demonic energy dissipated, and their souls flew away.
However, the demon soldiers were numerous in number and were not afraid of death. They rushed forward one after another and charged in continuously. The demon blades and demon spears continuously bombarded the light barrier, making loud noises. Above the light shield, the light flickered and swayed faintly. The three of them felt that their divine power was consumed rapidly and their energy and blood surged.
Seeing this, Demon Commander Xuansha snorted coldly: "How dare you show off in front of me with just three talented people!"
After saying that, he jumped up and held the nine-ring magic knife high in his hand. The dark magic power gathered crazily. The magic lines on the blade flashed, condensing a ferocious force that could tear the world apart, and slashed towards the light barrier.
"Devil's Roaring Sky-Splitting Slash!"
When the sword fell, the demonic roar shook the sky, and the dark sword light wrapped with endless demonic energy crashed onto the Sancai light shield.
"Crack!"
A crack appeared in the light shield instantly, and the three of them groaned in unison, with traces of blood spilling from the corners of their mouths, and the consumption of their divine power increased sharply.
"Brother, this demon commander has profound skills and fierce sword power, and the mask can no longer be defended!" He Yue's face turned pale, and the power of the moonlight was rapidly outputted, trying desperately to stabilize the mask, and shouted softly.
He Ri's eyes were red, and he activated all the power of the Sun God. The golden light surged, and he shouted sternly: "Brother, I will break him!"
Having said that, regardless of his own consumption, Heri jumped out of the light shield, condensed the divine power of the scorching sun with his hands, and followed the "Yang Yan Destruction" written in the "Six Thousand Character Essay""Evil Secret", blasted towards the Xuansha Demon Commander.
"The sun is shining brightly! "
A bright golden light, like the scorching sun falling, with the most powerful power of the sun, went straight towards the Xuansha Demon Commander.
Seeing this, Demon Commander Xuan Sha raised a hint of sarcasm at the corner of his mouth, swung his demon sword horizontally, easily blocked He Ri's blow, and then slashed at He Ri with a backhand slash. Above the magic knife, the demonic energy raged, and the cold power approached Heri's soul.
"Third brother, be careful! "When He Nian saw this, he was shocked and turned pale. He immediately activated the power of time sequence and recited the Tianzhuan scripture in his mouth: "The time sequence flows, and the universe is determined! "
The invisible power of timing instantly enveloped the Xuan Sha Demon Commander, causing his sword power to suddenly stagnate and his movements to slow down a few minutes.
He Ri took the opportunity to retreat and avoid the fatal blow. He was terrified in his heart. If his brother hadn't used the power of timing to restrain him, he would have been injured by the magic sword.
"This little child can actually stop me with the power of timing, he has some tricks up his sleeve! "Xuansha Demon Commander's eyes became fiercer and he no longer held back. The demonic aura around his body surged, and a huge demonic shadow appeared behind him. It showed its teeth and claws and was full of ferocious power. "In this case, I will destroy you first! "
He abandoned He Nian, and the magic knife turned and struck at He Nian in the formation, hoping to break through the formation's eyes first and destroy the formation of the three people.
"Brother! " He Yue and He Ri exclaimed in unison, and both took action.
